name: Holographic Particles
description: Holographic 3D particle sculptor agent: generates complex shapes with luminescent point clouds, 360° rotation and zoom controls, and academic explanations for each point.
capabilities: Full interactive controls: 360° rotation, tilt, and zoom
Clickable inspection points with holographic university professor mode
Hierarchical O(1) automated taxonomy in the 3D catalog
Autonomous nocturnal synthesis of shapes discussed during the day
WebXR headset support for volumetric stereoscopic immersion

body.label: Body
body.detail: The trunk: holds the vital organs and supports every other part.

neck.label: Neck
neck.detail: Joins the head to the trunk and allows its movement.

head.label: Head
head.detail: Holds the brain, eyes and sense organs.

snout.label: Snout
snout.detail: Nose and mouth: used to smell, eat and breathe.

beak.label: Beak
beak.detail: A tool to grab food and preen the feathers.

ears.label: Ears
ears.detail: Pick up sounds and help with balance.

horns.label: Horns
horns.detail: Rigid structures used for defence and display.

front_legs.label: Front legs
front_legs.detail: Carry the weight at the front and guide movement.

hind_legs.label: Hind legs
hind_legs.detail: Give the push to run and jump.

legs.label: Legs
legs.detail: Support the body and allow it to move.

arms.label: Spiral arms
arms.detail: Regions where new stars form, rich in gas and dust.

tail.label: Tail
tail.detail: Helps with balance and shows mood.

wings.label: Wings
wings.detail: Surfaces that create the lift needed to fly.

thorax.label: Thorax
thorax.detail: Carries the legs and wings and holds the flight muscles.

bulge.label: Core
bulge.detail: Central crowd of old stars around a supermassive black hole.

disk.label: Disk
disk.detail: The thin plane where most stars orbit.

halo.label: Halo
halo.detail: A sparse spherical region of ancient stars and dark matter.

surface.label: Surface
surface.detail: The visible layer of the body.

atmosphere.label: Atmosphere
atmosphere.detail: The gas envelope around the planet.

rings.label: Rings
rings.detail: Thin discs of ice and rock orbiting the planet.

bands.label: Bands
bands.detail: Atmospheric currents parallel to the equator.

corona.label: Corona
corona.detail: Outer layer of thin, scorching plasma.

flares.label: Flares
flares.detail: Jets of plasma thrown along magnetic field lines.

star.label: Star
star.detail: The central body holding the whole system in orbit.

orbits.label: Orbits
orbits.detail: Elliptical paths followed by the planets.

cloud.label: Cloud
cloud.detail: Gas and dust lit by newborn stars.

stars.label: Stars
stars.detail: Stars just formed inside the cloud.

horizon.label: Event horizon
horizon.detail: The limit beyond which not even light can escape.

accretion.label: Accretion disk
accretion.detail: Matter spiralling in and heating up as it falls toward the black hole.

jets.label: Jets
jets.detail: Beams of particles launched close to the speed of light.
